class.name: NetwSchemaColumn
class.brief_description: One column exactly as a [NetwSchema] declares it, with no session behind it.
class.description: A column as authored, before any session compiled it into a table. It carries no session state and no RID, which is what lets a declaration be written in a [code]static var[/code] initializer that runs before any session exists. Columns are never built directly. [method NetwSchema.column] appends them in address order, and that order is the wire address every adopting peer seals in.

members.member: The caller-facing name, unique within its declaration.
